in_marathi.name: Rangaswamy
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of colors and music
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rangaswamy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rangaswamy is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Ranga' which means 'color' and 'Swamy' which means 'god'. The name is believed to be a reference to Lord Rama, who is often depicted as being adorned with various colors. The name also signifies the divine presence of music and color in one's life.
